svg.text: attention weights, one head, deeper layer (rows sum to 1)
the first column is dark in most rows
a head that has nothing useful to read still has to put its mass somewhere;
the first token is always visible to every query, so it becomes the drain
the mass lands on a token whose content is semantically empty (Xiao et al.'s reading)
consequence (W5): evict the first token from the cache and the model breaks;
keep it and a sliding window works — StreamingLLM
phenomenon: Xiao et al. 2023. Why it happens: still argued in 2025.
